scripts.dev: bun run build:daemon && if [ -f ../../.devstack.json ]; then set -a && source ../../.env && set +a && bun run tauri dev --config tauri.stack.json; else bun run tauri dev --config tauri.local.conf.json; fi
scripts.dev:update-test: bun run build:daemon && bun run tauri dev --config tauri.localtest.conf.json
scripts.build:daemon: cd ../.. && set -a && source .env && turbo run build:local --filter @humanlayer/riptide-daemon && cp apps/riptide-daemon/dist/daemon apps/riptide-native/bin/riptided
